question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Quite" **is used here to emphasize the extent of the fortune** teller's shock.**
 
• The adverb** "quite"** enhances the intensity of the **adjective "shocked," making the expression stronger.**
 
• The usage of** "quite shocked"** is a common, grammatically **correct phrase in English.**
 
• **"Quite"** fits the context well, describing the **emotional reaction** of the fortune teller adequately.
 
• Other options do not fit **grammatically or contextually in the given sentence.**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (many): "Many"** is used to describe a large number of countable items and does not fit the context of describing the level of shock.
 
• **Option 3 (so less):** **"So less" **is grammatically incorrect; **"less"** is used with uncountable nouns and does not fit the instance of measuring shock.
 
• **Option 4 (so more):** **"So more"** is also grammatically incorrect and does not make sense in the given context.
